bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 14, 2017

The Creative Arts Center in Chatham is currently holding its 22nd Annual All Cape Cod Art Show – Open Juried Exhibition through Wednesday, June 28.

Many Guild of Harwich Artists are represented in the exhibit which showcases 138 works of art in various mediums. Awarded “Best of Show” at the opening reception on June 4, was Guild of Harwich Artists member Martha Little Fuentes for her oil painting “Blue Theo”. Also, congratulations to Larry Folding for second place in watercolor for “Winter Warmth”.

Guild of Harwich Artists members accepted and exhibiting in this juried show are:
Lydia Bell
Larry Folding
Martha Little Fuentes
Barbara Quinn Grasso
Kathleen Magnusson
Doris Mee
Elaine Felos Ostrander
Brian Powers
Maryrose Reynolds
Yvette Stenzel
Jeanne Tassinari
Katherine Vacca
Dianne Wadsworth
